title: deployer: pave provision.root + provision.member for aws org wishes
description:
## .what

pave declastruct provision for an aws organization: `provision.root` (plan/apply a wish against the management account, guarded so it refuses any other account) and `provision.member` (plan/apply a wish against one member account, its profile from a keyrack slot per env + org).

## .why

`provision.declastruct` covers one account. an org needs two more shapes: the root wishes (accounts, sso admins, budgets) that must only ever run in the management account, and per-member wishes (e.g. a mail stack per env). prior art: `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron` `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/provision.root.sh` and `provision.member.sh` (main).

## .ask

- same `--wish --mode plan|apply --gate` contract as provision.declastruct
- root: per-key keyrack unlock loop; refuses when the caller account is not the management account
- member: `--env --org` picks the slot; refuses with the unlock command when absent
- acceptance snapshots of each refusal + a gated live plan
